name: Hungary
summary: Using or holding even a small amount is a crime (up to 2 yrs); more is 2–8 yrs or worse. Diversion to a 6-month programme is limited since 2025 (twice max, must reveal the source). Rules unchanged as of Oct 2026.
callingForHelp: No Good Samaritan protection. Drug use itself is a crime and police may get involved, although medical staff are bound by confidentiality.
drugChecking: No drug checking service operates in Hungary.

btk.title: Criminal Code (Act C of 2012), §§ 178–180 and 461 (version in force from 1 Oct 2026)

lsd.note: Holding up to 0.001 g pure LSD ('small amount') for own use: up to 2 yrs or diversion; more: 2–8 yrs.

mushrooms.note: Treated by psilocybin content: up to 0.1 g psilocybin (0.2 g psilocin) is a 'small amount' (up to 2 yrs or diversion); more: 2–8 yrs.

dmt.note: DMT is listed; small amount is set per case (7× an effective dose, about 0.35 g). Ayahuasca and harmine are also controlled.

mescaline.note: Mescaline is listed; possession for own use is a crime (up to 2 yrs for a small amount, 2–8 yrs above).

dox.note: DOB, DOC etc. are listed and a generic phenethylamine group covers relatives; possession is a crime.

nbomes.note: 25I-NBOMe is listed and the NPS generic phenethylamine group covers other NBOMes; possession is a crime.

2c-x.note: 2C-B and other 2C-x are listed or covered by the generic phenethylamine group; possession is a crime.

2c-t-x.note: 2C-T-7 and other 2C-T-x are listed or covered by the generic phenethylamine group; possession is a crime.

5-meo-xxt.note: A generic NPS group covers 4-/5-methoxy tryptamines (5-MeO-DMT, 5-MeO-MiPT…), and NPS count as drugs; possession is a crime.

cannabis.note: Small amount: ≤6 g total THC (roughly 30+ g of strong herb) or ≤5 plants: up to 2 yrs or diversion. More: 2–8 yrs. HHC banned. No medical access.

ketamine.note: A medicine, but possession without a prescription is a drug crime (small amount: ≤1 g pure ketamine, up to 2 yrs).

mxe.note: Methoxetamine is listed; possession is a crime (up to 2 yrs for a small amount).

dxm.note: Not a controlled drug (the decree excludes it). Sold as a cough medicine in pharmacies; prescription/OTC status not verified.

nitrous.note: Not on the controlled-substance or NPS lists; no specific consumer ban was found.

amphetamines.note: Small amount ≤0.5 g pure amphetamine/methamphetamine: up to 2 yrs or diversion; more: 2–8 yrs. ADHD medicines are prescription-only.

mdma.note: Small amount ≤1 g pure MDMA: up to 2 yrs or diversion; more: 2–8 yrs. Near schools/dorms: 1–5 yrs even for small amounts.

cocaine.note: Small amount ≤2 g pure cocaine: up to 2 yrs or diversion; more: 2–8 yrs.

caffeine.note: Legal and not a controlled substance.

alcohol.note: Legal from 18; sale to minors is prohibited.

ghb/gbl.note: GHB and GBL are listed drugs (small amount: 7.5 g GHB, 6.2 g GBL; up to 2 yrs or diversion). Oxybate is prescription-only.

opioids.note: Heroin small amount ≤0.6 g pure (up to 2 yrs); more 2–8 yrs. Morphine, oxycodone, fentanyl are prescription-only.

tramadol.note: Prescription-only medicine; not on the controlled-drug lists, so possession without a prescription is not a drug crime.

benzodiazepines.note: Prescription-only (psychotropic lists P3/P4, not 'drugs' for possession offences). Dealing them, or hoarding unauthorised ones, is a crime.

maois.note: Harmine is on the NPS list, which counts as a drug, so Syrian rue/ayahuasca extracts risk prosecution. Pharmaceutical MAOIs are Rx-only.
